alerts.reason: Cato attributed its 34.2% fiscal 2021 retail sales rebound partly to stimulus, reopening and renewed demand for social and work clothing (A, B). I expect the quarter beginning May 1 to face a tougher reopening comparison than the preceding quarter. With inflation also threatening customers’ disposable income (D), I forecast year-over-year sales growth above -5% in the preceding quarter and at or below -5% in the target quarter. The timing is inferred from annual figures.
